note: Rules no script or test can judge: a person looks. Hand-maintained; seeded from the proposed_check of the rules that said 'manual'. A rule listed here that a check cites is reported as enforced and flagged in the registry integrity section. scripts/rules-check.py reads this file; the key is the rule ID, the value says why it is manual and what the person looks at.
